verdict.rationale: Dependent visas are a fair question for an immigration law firm, so the axis applies. The firm lists principal work visas (O-1, H-1B, L-1, E-3, TN), but nothing in the evidence mentions O-3, H-4, L-2, or dependent work authorization as part of the service. The family sponsorship reference covers US citizens sponsoring relatives, a different category from derivative dependent visas, so it does not count here.
